title: Team Roster
description: Written by the orchestrator at team formation. Lists all workers and their cross-review assignments. All workers are the same agent type as the orchestrator. Domain-agnostic.

agentType.description: The agent type all workers share (same as orchestrator). e.g. 'web-artisan', 'backend-dev'.

taskDescription.description: Natural language description of what this team is doing.

invokedBy.description: What invoked this team — an agent definition or a direct command.

agentRef.description: Path to agent .md file if embedded mode.

command.description: Original command string if command mode.

spec.description: One-line description of what this worker is responsible for. Domain-specific content supplied by the invoking agent.

crossReviewAssignments.description: Worker IDs this worker must review after completing its own work. Never includes self.

crossReviewPairs.description: Explicit worker-to-worker cross-review pairs. Every worker reviews at least one peer and is reviewed by at least one peer. No self-review.

parallelWorkstreams.description: Logical groupings of workers that can execute concurrently.

dependsOn.description: Stream IDs that must complete before this stream begins.
